output.summary: Eleanor Vance (68F) experienced an acute -22.2% decline in kidney filtration rate (eGFR drop from 54 to 42 mL/min/1.73m²; Creatinine increase from 1.28 to 1.82 mg/dL) following the initiation of Meloxicam 15mg daily prescribed by an outside Urgent Care on 2026-10-10. The combination of an NSAID with pre-existing Lisinopril 20mg in the setting of CKD Stage 3a has provoked hemodynamically mediated acute renal stress and mild hyperkalemia (K+ 5.2 mEq/L).

acute_alerts.title: Acute Nephrotoxicity from Dual ACE-Inhibitor + NSAID Therapy
acute_alerts.description: Severe drug-drug and drug-condition interaction between newly prescribed Meloxicam 15mg and chronic Lisinopril 20mg in the setting of pre-existing CKD Stage 3a.
acute_alerts.mechanism: NSAIDs inhibit renal prostaglandins causing afferent arteriolar constriction; ACE inhibitors block Angiotensin II causing efferent arteriolar vasodilation. Dual action causes severe drop in intraglomerular perfusion pressure.

evidence_citations.source: Outpatient EHR / Hope Valley Medical Group

evidence_citations.entity: eGFR drop to 42 mL/min (-22.2%), Cr 1.82 mg/dL

acute_alerts.action_recommendation: Immediately discontinue Meloxicam. Transition to non-nephrotoxic analgesic regimens (e.g., topical NSAIDs, acetaminophen, physical therapy). Recheck Basic Metabolic Panel within 7-10 days.

discussion_questions: Given Mom's pre-existing Stage 3a kidney disease and Lisinopril therapy, could the Meloxicam 15mg prescribed at Urgent Care on Oct 10 have caused her eGFR to drop from 54 to 42 mL/min?
Should we discontinue Meloxicam immediately and switch to a non-nephrotoxic knee pain alternative like topical Diclofenac or acetaminophen?
When should we recheck her Basic Metabolic Panel (eGFR, Creatinine, and Potassium) to ensure her kidney function is rebounding?
With her potassium currently at 5.2 mEq/L, do we need to make any temporary adjustments to her diet or Lisinopril dose while her kidneys recover?
Does her Metformin dosage need a temporary reduction while her eGFR is below 45 mL/min?
action_plan: Immediate step: Hold Meloxicam 15mg doses pending today's physician consultation.
Bring this printed 90-Day Trend Sheet and the outside Urgent Care discharge note to the doctor's office.
Ensure adequate hydration and monitor for any new ankle swelling or fluid retention.
Schedule follow-up renal panel lab appointment within 7 to 10 days post-consultation.
